title: Web API endpoints — concept map
intro: This module covers how ASP.NET Core maps URLs to your C# code — controllers versus minimal APIs, endpoint routing, model binding, parameter sources like [AsParameters], action results with TypedResults, content negotiation, and file upload/download. Both endpoint styles share the same routing table and binding infrastructure; the choice is structure and filters, not performance.

conceptCards.title: Controllers vs minimal APIs
conceptCards.summary: Both register RouteEndpoints in the same table. Controllers: [ApiController], filters, ActionResult<T>. Minimal: MapGet, IEndpointFilter, TypedResults. Pick by team structure and filter needs.

conceptCards.title: Endpoint routing
conceptCards.summary: Route templates with constraints (:guid, :int). Literal segments beat {id}. MapGroup prefixes routes. WithName for link generation.

conceptCards.title: Model binding
conceptCards.summary: Maps HTTP data to typed parameters. [ApiController] infers sources. ModelState errors become 400. System.Text.Json for body.
conceptCards.example: PUT {id} + UpdateOrderRequest body without explicit attributes

conceptCards.title: Binding sources
conceptCards.summary: [FromRoute], [FromQuery], [FromHeader], [FromBody], [FromForm]. [AsParameters] bundles query fields into one record.

conceptCards.title: Action results
conceptCards.summary: IActionResult and IResult defer response writing. ActionResult<T> and TypedResults.Ok<T> document success types. Problem Details for errors.

conceptCards.title: Content negotiation
conceptCards.summary: Output formatters serialize ObjectResult. Accept header selects format — JSON is the modern default. Align JsonOptions and HttpJsonOptions.

conceptCards.title: File upload/download
conceptCards.summary: IFormFile from multipart/form-data. Stream to blob storage. File() and Results.File for downloads. Set Kestrel and proxy size limits.
